question: Among species recruited into the wetter route, do dynamic soil wetness and historical local strong-chorus template breadth independently predict how deeply the species spreads across stops?
population: Physically stable NAAMP matched pairs with valid ERA5 swvl1/swvl2 and 72 h precipitation for both runs. Focal species are absent from the dry route, present in the wet route, and recorded somewhere in the same route-season stratum strictly before the earlier focal-pair year.

predictors.prior_strong_breadth: Fraction of currently sampled physical SiteIDs with prior sampling opportunity at which the species had CallingIndex 2-3 before the focal pair; require >=8 opportunity SiteIDs.
predictors.soil1_gain_z: z-scored wet-run minus dry-run ERA5 swvl1 at survey midpoint.
predictors.rain72_z: z-scored wet-minus-dry log1p 72 h precipitation amount.
predictors.prior_route_frequency: Fraction of prior eligible runs in which species occurred anywhere on route; nuisance control.

primary_model: third_plus_depth ~ z_prior_strong_breadth + soil1_gain_z + z_prior_strong_breadth:soil1_gain_z + rain72_z + rain_contrast + prior_route_frequency + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(species) + C(State) + C(RunNumber), route-clustered covariance.

prefixed_interpretation.additive_two_axis: Both z_prior_strong_breadth and soil1_gain_z have positive complete 95% CIs, while their interaction CI includes zero.
prefixed_interpretation.coupled_gate_template: Both main effects and their interaction have positive complete 95% CIs.
prefixed_interpretation.neither: Neither main effect has complete positive CI.

secondary: Repeat primary in same-observer pairs if >=1000 focal pair-species, >=250 routes and >=20 species.
Report rain72 after soil1 as a nuisance hydric comparison.
minimum_gate: At least 1500 focal pair-species, >=300 routes, >=20 species, SD(prior_strong_breadth)>=0.10.
interpretation: This conditions on wet-route recruitment and therefore models spatial depth, not initial activation probability.
Support for both main effects would connect a dynamic hydric gate with a persistent species-specific spatial template.
An absent interaction means the two axes are approximately separable rather than soil wetness selectively amplifying remembered sites.
No continuous occupancy, individual movement, body hydration, pond-depth, breeding-success or causal mediation claim is authorized.
